archetypes.name: dyn-kv-wire
archetypes.rationale: Shared codec policy changes can subtly alter duplicate and fallback semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the new duplicate-policy API and each migrated caller. Verify first, last, all, empty-value, CR, decode, and symlink behavior remains compatible with its former contract. Check that scalar APIs cannot accept the ordered all policy. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
